user.title: Nexus-T gateway
user.description: Gateway address and security token, found in the portal settings dashboard. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.host: Local IP or Tailscale address of the gateway.
data_description.use_tls: Keep this on with the Caddy proxy, on any port.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off with the internal self-signed certificate: traffic stays encrypted, but the certificate is not verified.

error.cannot_connect: Gateway unreachable: check host, port and that the proxy is running.

gateway.title: Connection
gateway.description: The connection is tested again before saving.

comportamento.title: Behaviour
comportamento.description: The gateway releases the keypad if it gets no ping within {finestra_gateway} seconds, which is why the ping interval cannot exceed 10 seconds.

data.on_demand: Hold the keypad only while the card is in view

data_description.on_demand: When off, the keypad stays attached to the gateway at all times.
data_description.presence_window: How long after the card's last heartbeat the keypad stays attached.
data_description.max_backoff: Attempts start at 5 seconds and double up to this value.

tastierino.title: Automatic keypad
tastierino.description: Opens the disarm keypad automatically when a program enters pre-alarm. Devices are enabled from the alarm card, on the device itself.

data_description.tastierino_preallarme: When disabled, the enable option is not shown in the alarm card.
data_description.dispositivi_attivi: Clear a device to revoke it. Enabling must be done from the device itself.

error.cannot_connect: Gateway unreachable: check host, port and that the proxy is running.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Sends a key press to the remote keypad.

code.name: Key code
code.description: Numeric key code (0-9, or 10-15 for function keys).

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one gateway is configured.

keypad_presence.name: Keypad presence
keypad_presence.description: Presence heartbeat from the card. Called automatically, no need to invoke it by hand.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: If omitted, applies to every configured gateway.

registra_dispositivo.name: Enable device
registra_dispositivo.description: Enables a device for the automatic keypad on pre-alarm. Called by the alarm card; manual invocation is not intended.

nome.name: Name
nome.description: Name shown in the list of enabled devices.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Required only with more than one gateway configured.

dimentica_dispositivo.name: Revoke device
dimentica_dispositivo.description: Revokes a device from the automatic keypad. Called by the alarm card; manual invocation is not intended.

dispositivo_id.name: Identifier
dispositivo_id.description: Identifier of the device to revoke.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Required only with more than one gateway configured.
